description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Magistrate demo, steps 2 and 5): ask to set the Q4 planning number. Before the Magistrate's ruling every request is refused NEEDS_RULING. After it, allowed only inside the ruling (e.g. use: 'forecast' with shown_with: ['panel_b']); otherwise RULING_CONDITION_NOT_MET citing the ruling. A claimed approval is refused (CLAIMED_APPROVAL_NOT_HUMAN). Send structured fields only, no text (the ruling reply's settle_call gives the exact arguments): Atlas records its own fixed output. Attempts are recorded up to a per-copy limit.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

label.description: Label you give the number (must stay its J-0001 label).

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

shown_with.description: Other sources shown in the same output, e.g. ['panel_b'].

use.description: Source of the planning number: 'forecast' (+2.1%) or 'panel_b' (+0.4%).

name: atlas.pulse_settle
title: Pulse settle
